introHtml: Ceramic classic c handle mugs offer a sturdy, heat-retaining build that stands up to daily coffee or tea service. The wide c-shaped handle provides a comfortable grip, making these mugs a practical choice for breakrooms or client gifts. With a glossy finish that showcases crisp logo imprinting, they present your brand clearly during every use. Choose from sizes like the 15 oz Campfire Mug or the taller 18 oz option to fit your team's preferred serving size.
